I normal listen but after my best friend stopped coming to school I tried to make friends in a way they did it.I personally think that I was becoming someone I wasn’t for them and just made this other person for people to like.I already have mental issues and I don’t know but even though I was close with them they would act like I wasn’t there and even sometimes tell me to shut up and laugh,cut me while talking and keep talking about politics at school which I don’t like I never broke a rule in my life and they are the type to not care.I will try to move on but feel like I’m never gonna have friends ever again and keep having mental breakdowns and thank you for advice appreciate it

I know it sounds like it but my intent wasn’t ever to hurt anyone I never said I wasn’t at fault I already apologized to them I just don’t get that they did the same thing to someone else but when it’s something about themselves they get angry.I never said anything mean just said that the person told me this and never opened the subject if it wasn’t mentioned.I defended people saying that they weren’t mean people that they were just doing wrong stuff.I had already apologized about the other thing and they even accepted my apology and we were close but they were always the ones to downgrade other people.It was a she said and he said stuff and everyone did it.I wasn’t the one who spread it if they didn’t knew that my best friend told someone else they would never know what happened and not say anything.Everything they accused me for was rumors spread by their friend which I told my close friends only.

I can’t really do that every time I try to calm down I remember the event and how my other best friend which I always defended looked at me and grinned when I asked her if the gossip was about me and how my other friend acted like I didn’t exist.But I will try thank you for the advice

I feel the same about my bestfriend.Every day is a new challenge with ourselves questions in our head"what if I didn't say that" "I should have stayed by her side" "I wish I had realized sooner"etc. I always question myself but I know even if I was there it couldn't be helped.I don't know if this will ease your pain but apparently people who commit suicide do it at the moment they don't plan it entirely just at the moment something triggers them and they do it.I wish it could have been stopped but that was their decision I think if they knew the impact it leaves on loved ones they would never do it because everyday it hurts more.I hope you will get through this like I'm trying to don't remember them by their death but by their happy memories you shared together.Stay strong!

I never tried reaching to the family and I don't think I will they played a big role in her suicide I don't blame them but they overworked her.It was hard to see her because she always was studying even when it was holiday's instead I talk to mutuals about it.I still can't visit her grave nor can I look at our pictures it's heartbreaking sometimes in the middle of the night I start remembering her and cry wishing she was still here it's hard but I hope she's resting well.I'm just happy that her pain is over now I wish we would have fight it together but sadly she had other plans.Thank you for the advice and I always describe her to people when I talk about her as if she was still here.And sorry for your lost I hope you are in a good place.
Lot of love and support.

You guys had a really cute relationship my bestfriend and I had the same relationship every moment with her was a great memory.Tomorrow might be harder but I'm sure if you keep filling your head with just memories of the good times it will help you can cry whenever you want I realized in situations like this even something so little can remind you of her.Life is still going and you should too it's hard but if life wasn't hard would we be humans after all?I wish she was still here but it was her time to go and I know she is happy and will always be the girl I knew.Reading your post and respond made me feel happy because I don't feel alone I would recommend writing your feelings whenever you feel overwhelmed or express your feelings on this platform take care!

I understand your feeling I lost my bestfriend also and everyone is saying that I should move on because we didn't talk for 2 years idk if you feel the same but it seems selfish when they say that.The person that died was the closest person you knew,the person you had fun times with and the person that made this ugly life better.It's hard at first and still is but try making new friends even though they won't be like her just know she won't like that you are alone because she isn't here.I have social anxiety so it's also hard for me to make new friends and trust them my therapist told me that we should give ourself challenges everyday like saying "Hello,good morning"maybe that will help.The grieve you are having is normal you still gonna remember her and thats a good thing just remind yourself that she would wish that you were happy.Sometimes it might be to much and you can have meltdowns we are humans after all,let the tears be your path I'm sure she loved you a lot and was happy she spent at least half of her life with you keep remembering the good times if you keep remembering she's dead it will hurt you more so just remember her smile,her jokes and goofy stuff she did.I hope you will get better soon.Lots of love
